lines.trans: An adult video actress in a major corporate ad—times really have changed.
Somehow I still can't quite get used to it.
Appetite and sexual desire are closely connected. It is a wonderful thing.
What you're wearing right now suits you best. White is the symbol of innocence.
I heard she worked at a department store beauty counter. She has great taste.
Oh my, then perhaps I'll ask you to pick something for me too. I have an ad shoot coming up.
I'd love to! How about something like this?
You truly have lovely taste. Why did you leave your job?
That liberation of women's sexuality, as you call it—I admired that and wanted to try it myself.
Until she makes her debut, teach her what being an actress is all about.
Oh my, would I do? You are most welcome.
Thank you so much, I'm thrilled. Doesn't Mr. Muranishi direct anymore?
